acceptance: unchanged independent physical/task/safety/scientific evaluator; early failure gets no ranked score
action: continuous Box[-1,1]^2, hip/knee bounded target changes; no old lattice projection
actor_firewall: estimated causal state/belief and measured wrench only; no truth, future, oracle geometry, CEM identity
allow_two_workers: only after RSS evidence; max2; never3+
curriculum: only initialization difficulty/shaping strength; same physics/endpoints/evaluator
development_split: Both previously studied conditions; no held-out/generalization claim
git: stage individually; no merge; no force push; no push without existing/explicit authorization
low_rom_context: same source checkpoint repetition 1, adaptation state of existing ordinary session; not independent patient
physics: same validated CPU MuJoCo, CR12-cuff physical path; no Human-state or torque actuation
primary_score: J_F_task = integral ||F_cuff_measured|| dt over COMPLETE OUTBOUND -> HOLD -> RETURN
quadrature: existing 5ms left quadrature; preserve original terminal boundary accounting
rate_diagnostic_gate: existing action/safety interface must support each period with reference continuity and complete task
retention: compact training summaries/checkpoints; full traces only validation/evaluation/forensic; no bulk cleanup
reward: negative measured force interval integral + task potential + optional valid completion bonus - explicit failure penalty; no action/coordination imitation reward; final reward not yet selected
stop_conditions: existing authoritative safety tied to old representation cannot screen expanded action

training_budget.second_seed: full if time permits else shorter independent seed
